```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyRSS)
library(dplyr)

library(lubridate)
library(DT)
library(plotly)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(xml2)

Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "C")

rss_sources <- tibble::tribble(
  ~source,                   ~url,
  "EU Observer",             "https://euobserver.com/feed/",
  "Balkan Insight",          "https://balkaninsight.com/feed/",
  "European Western Balkans","https://europeanwesternbalkans.com/feed/",
  "The Loop (ECPR)",         "https://theloop.ecpr.eu/feed/",
  "European Parliament Press","https://www.europarl.europa.eu/rss/doc/press-news/en.xml",
  "EP Foreign Affairs Cmte", "https://www.europarl.europa.eu/rss/committee/afet/en.xml"
)


keywords <- c(
  "enlargement", "accession", "candidate country", "candidate status",
  "Western Balkans", "Ukraine EU", "Moldova EU", "Georgia EU",
  "acquis", "membership talks", "accession negotiations",
  "rule of law", "copenhagen criteria", "screening process",
  "Serbia EU", "Kosovo EU", "Montenegro EU", "North Macedonia EU",
  "Albania EU", "Bosnia EU", "Turkey EU accession"
)

keyword_regex <- paste(keywords, collapse = "|")

browser_ua <- user_agent("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36")

fetch_feed <- function(source_name, url) {
  tryCatch({
    res <- GET(url, browser_ua)
    if (status_code(res) != 200) stop(paste("HTTP", status_code(res)))

    xml <- read_xml(content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
    items <- xml_find_all(xml, "//item")
    if (length(items) == 0) stop("No items found in feed")

    get_child_text <- function(item, tag) {
      node <- xml_find_first(item, paste0(".//", tag))
      if (inherits(node, "xml_missing")) NA_character_ else xml_text(node)
    }

    pubdate_raw   <- map_chr(items, get_child_text, tag = "pubDate")
    pubdate_clean <- str_remove(pubdate_raw, "\\s+([A-Za-z]+|[+-]\\d{4})$")  # strip trailing tz (GMT, +0000, etc.)

    tibble::tibble(
      source      = source_name,
      title       = map_chr(items, get_child_text, tag = "title"),
      link        = map_chr(items, get_child_text, tag = "link"),
      published   = parse_date_time(pubdate_clean,
                                     orders = c("a, d b Y H:M:S", "Y-m-d H:M:S"),
                                     tz = "UTC"),
      description = map_chr(items, get_child_text, tag = "description")
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("Failed to fetch:", source_name, "-", e$message))
    tibble::tibble(source = character(), title = character(),
                    link = character(), published = as_datetime(character()),
                    description = character())
  })
}

rss_articles <- map2_dfr(rss_sources$source, rss_sources$url, fetch_feed)

gnews_api_key <- Sys.getenv("GNEWS_API_KEY", unset = "")

fetch_gnews <- function(query, api_key, max_results = 20) {
  if (api_key == "") return(tibble::tibble(
    source = character(), title = character(), link = character(),
    published = as_datetime(character()), description = character()
  ))
  url <- paste0("https://gnews.io/api/v4/search?q=", URLencode(query),
                "&lang=en&max=", max_results, "&apikey=", api_key)
  tryCatch({
    res <- GET(url)
    parsed <- fromJSON(content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
    if (is.null(parsed$articles) || length(parsed$articles) == 0) {
      return(tibble::tibble(source = character(), title = character(),
                             link = character(), published = as_datetime(character()),
                             description = character()))
    }
    articles_df <- parsed$articles

    if ("source.name" %in% names(articles_df)) {
      source_names <- articles_df$source.name
    } else if ("source" %in% names(articles_df) && is.data.frame(articles_df$source)) {
      source_names <- articles_df$source$name
    } else {
      source_names <- NA_character_
    }

    tibble::tibble(
      source      = source_names,
      title       = articles_df$title,
      link        = articles_df$url,
      published   = as_datetime(articles_df$publishedAt),
      description = articles_df$description
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("GNews fetch failed:", e$message))
    tibble::tibble(source = character(), title = character(),
                    link = character(), published = as_datetime(character()),
                    description = character())
  })
}


rss_articles <- map2_dfr(rss_sources$source, rss_sources$url, fetch_feed)


fetch_gnews <- function(query, api_key, max_results = 20) {
  if (api_key == "") return(tibble::tibble(
    source = character(), title = character(), link = character(),
    published = as_datetime(character()), description = character()
  ))
  url <- paste0("https://gnews.io/api/v4/search?q=", URLencode(query),
                "&lang=en&max=", max_results, "&apikey=", api_key)
  tryCatch({
    res <- GET(url)
    parsed <- fromJSON(content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
    if (is.null(parsed$articles) || length(parsed$articles) == 0) {
      return(tibble::tibble(source = character(), title = character(),
                             link = character(), published = as_datetime(character()),
                             description = character()))
    }
    articles_df <- parsed$articles

    # GNews sometimes returns 'source' as a flattened "source.name" column,
    # and sometimes as a nested data frame column called "source". Handle both.
    if ("source.name" %in% names(articles_df)) {
      source_names <- articles_df$source.name
    } else if ("source" %in% names(articles_df) && is.data.frame(articles_df$source)) {
      source_names <- articles_df$source$name
    } else {
      source_names <- NA_character_
    }

    tibble::tibble(
      source      = source_names,
      title       = articles_df$title,
      link        = articles_df$url,
      published   = as_datetime(articles_df$publishedAt),
      description = articles_df$description
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("GNews fetch failed:", e$message))
    tibble::tibble(source = character(), title = character(),
                    link = character(), published = as_datetime(character()),
                    description = character())
  })
}

gnews_articles <- bind_rows(
  fetch_gnews("EU enlargement", gnews_api_key, max_results = 10),
  fetch_gnews("EU accession Western Balkans", gnews_api_key, max_results = 10)
)

all_articles <- bind_rows(rss_articles, gnews_articles) %>%
  distinct(title, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(published)) %>%
  filter(published >= (Sys.time() - days(7))) %>%
  filter(str_detect(str_to_lower(paste(title, description)),
                     str_to_lower(keyword_regex))) %>%
  arrange(desc(published))

n_articles <- nrow(all_articles)
n_sources  <- n_distinct(all_articles$source)
```
